resources.string: Drawer beside the picture (off: drops down from the top)
Tall column: the timeline sits under the picture only
Automatic: beside the picture when there is room there, else drop down
Always drop down from the top, as on a phone
Beside the picture, the drawer runs the full height and the timeline sits under the picture only. Off: the editing desk, with the timeline full width.
The drawer stands on the left of the picture instead of the right.
Second drawer on the other side

When a small drawer (volume, opacity, loop, move...) opens with another drawer beside the picture, it stands on the other side of the picture, as in an editing suite. Off: it stacks above the other drawer in the same column.
